correctness.rationale: For every even \(M\ge4\), matchings give edge occurrence probabilities \(1/(M-1)\) and disjoint-edge joint probabilities \(1/((M-1)(M-3))\); these yield exactly the displayed nested-cut covariance. The sequential exposure is Markov with closing probability \(h/(M-k)\). Centered linear innovations have positive variances and yield an exact tridiagonal inverse and product determinant. For the Gaussian limit, the scaled martingale \(U_{M,k}=M^{3/2}(H_k-\mathbb EH_k)/((M-k)(M-k-1))\) has vanishing bounded jumps on compact time intervals and quadratic variation tending to \(2t^2/(1-t)^2\). Reversal and Doob bounds handle the endpoint. The full result is analytic; 450 exact small-instance checks passed using the included script.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact same uniform pairing object and its open-chord scan under multiple aliases. The 2015 Acan analysis treats degree and length of a specified chord and growth by insertion of complete chords; it gives no two-time prefix-cut kernel or full-process Gaussian fluctuation theorem. The 2018 open-chord transfer recurrence is broader enumerative machinery but does not evaluate this finite Green kernel and precision determinant or prove the stated functional central limit theorem. Accessible earlier claims concern shorter cyclic spans, crossing counts, and regular-color matching, not the prefix boundary profile. Generic recurrence machinery and potential older random pairing fluctuation literature are explicit priority risks; the evaluated structural claim is not judged covered by the sources actually inspected.

value.rationale: The complete process of open chords is a canonical scan statistic of random matchings. Its covariance kernel controls every weighted boundary statistic; the evaluated tridiagonal precision and determinant expose the finite second-order structure, while the nonstandard pinned time-changed Brownian limit describes genuine macroscopic fluctuations. The resulting aggregate chord-span central limit theorem illustrates a natural global use. These are not arbitrary substitutions or merely a known fixed-chord moment recomputation.
